Name: ActiveDirectoryCommon
Description: Shared Active Directory functions (library application): Move-AdUserToOu, Remove-AdUserAccount. Other applications list it in DependsOn. Needs the ActiveDirectory module (RSAT-AD-PowerShell). Bump Version whenever a file of this application changes.

Notes.DeletedUsersFolder: Remove-AdUserAccount writes a JSON record of every account before deleting it (attributes, group memberships, SID, GUID). The AD Recycle Bin is OFF in this forest (2026-10-27), so a deleted user can only be reanimated as a tombstone without its groups and most attributes; the record is what is left. Keep this folder backed up.
Notes.Delete.AllowedOUs: A user is only deleted when it is directly in one of these OUs (the former-employee workflow moves it to To.Delete first). [ "*" ] allows any OU. -AllowedOu on the call overrides.
Notes.Delete.RequireDisabled: Enabled accounts are refused (disable them first); -AllowEnabled on the call overrides.
Notes.Delete.RefuseWithMailbox: Accounts with an Exchange mailbox are refused (export or convert the mailbox first - To.MAKE_PST); -AllowMailbox on the call overrides.
Notes.Always refused: Built-in accounts (RID below 1000: Administrator, Guest, krbtgt ...) and privileged accounts (adminCount = 1: members, now or before, of Domain/Enterprise/Schema Admins, Administrators, Account/Server/Backup/Print Operators ...).
